falseSynonyms.zh: 早午餐不等於早餐 brunch 通常在較晚的上午或接近中午吃，結合 breakfast 和 lunch；不能一般地替代早餐。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON We ate breakfast at seven, but brunch is usually served much later.

falseSynonyms.zh: 小食不等於早餐 snack 是兩餐之間或份量較小的食物；早餐通常是一餐。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A banana can be a snack, while breakfast is a meal.

falseSynonyms.zh: 午餐不等於早餐 lunch 是中午前後的一餐，時間與 breakfast 不同。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Breakfast is eaten in the morning; lunch is eaten later in the day.

falseSynonyms.zh: 晚餐／宵夜不等於早餐 supper 通常指晚間的一餐，和早餐時間相反。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON They had breakfast in the morning and supper in the evening.

falseSynonyms.zh: 早餐食品不等於早餐本身 cereal 可以是早餐的一部分，但只是一種食物。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Cereal is one possible breakfast food, not breakfast itself.

falseSynonyms.zh: 早餐食品不一定等於完整早餐 breakfast food 指常在早餐吃的某種食物；breakfast 可以指整餐。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Eggs are a breakfast food. Eggs, toast, and fruit can make up a breakfast.

falseSynonyms.zh: 早餐時間不等於早餐 breakfast time 指吃早餐的時間，不是食物或一餐本身。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Breakfast time is at seven. Breakfast is served in the dining room.

falseSynonyms.zh: 早餐自助餐不等於早餐的一般概念 breakfast buffet 是供應早餐的一種形式，只適用於自助餐語境。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The hotel has a breakfast buffet, but breakfast can be served in many other ways.
